capabilities: open a home new-tab page with quick note, todo, and switcher actions
capture timestamped memos and todos into daily notes or a chosen file
view, filter by tag, and complete tasks in a sidebar with undo confirmation
navigate days with a calendar week/month view and see files modified that day
customize light and dark home backgrounds from images, URLs, or CSS gradients
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; supports BRAT beta installation.
problem: Obsidian has no single start-page or overview panel combining today's schedule, memos, open tasks, and recently modified notes in one view.
summary: Dashboard plugin that adds a new-tab home page and a sidebar with calendar navigation, daily memos, task management, and recent files.
